initialize_finetuning_model: initialize a fine-tuning MLIP model from a checkpoint with optional head overrides
compute_loss: compute multi-task loss for a batch of atomic data predictions across tasks
compute_metrics: compute evaluation metrics for a given task on a batch of atomic data predictions
MLIPTrainEvalUnit: create a train and eval unit for molecular machine learning models with DDP or FSDP strategy
MLIPEvalUnit: create an evaluation unit to evaluate molecular machine learning models on validation datasets
